name: Acme Corp — CFO approval and pilot kickoff planning (AE)
turns: Thanks for joining, Mark. Dana, Priya confirmed by email that security is cleared, so today is about the pilot.

I have approved the 18k pilot for Acme. Two conditions: Acme wants quarterly billing rather than annual upfront, and before we expand beyond the pilot I want to talk to a Northwind reference customer in logistics.
Quarterly billing is fine, and I will arrange a reference call with a logistics customer before the expansion decision.
Let us kick off the pilot on October 20. The success criterion is simple: Acme's vendor onboarding time has to drop from three weeks to one week for the six procurement users.
Three weeks to one week by the end of the pilot, understood. Who will run the pilot day to day on Acme's side?
That is the other change. I am moving to a new role in November, so from then on Northwind's main contact at Acme is Priya Raman, not me. Please copy her on everything from now on.
And copy me on anything that touches the invoice.
Will do. I will introduce Riley, our customer success manager at Northwind, who will run the kickoff on October 20.
rep_notes: Mark Chen (CFO) approved the Acme Corp $18k pilot on 2026-10-06 with two conditions: quarterly billing, and a reference call with a Northwind logistics customer before any expansion.
Open action item (Sam, AE): arrange the logistics reference call for Mark Chen before the Q2 expansion decision.
